projects.title: DEVDOCS AGENT — Local-First RAG Engine
projects.description: A privacy-first Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed for local technical documentation intelligence. Built with FastAPI, ChromaDB, LangChain, Ollama, and Phi-4-Mini, the engine supports Hybrid Search (BM25 + Semantic Retrieval), OCR fallback for scanned PDFs, persistent vector storage, and source-aware AI responses. Includes a modern Next.js frontend with Zustand-powered persistent UI state and a lightweight CLI interface for terminal-based interaction.

projects.title: Lead Intelligence System
projects.description: A machine learning-powered predictive analytics CRM built with FastAPI and Next.js. Designed to analyze customer conversion probability using a custom Logistic Regression model with transparent weight visualization, telemetry dashboards, batch scoring, and real-time inference tracking.

projects.title: Full-Stack Todo & Focus Timer App
projects.description: A productivity-focused application that combines task management with an integrated Pomodoro focus timer. Built with efficient global state management using Zustand and designed to improve workflow organization and concentration tracking.

projects.title: JobFu (Job Portal Web Platform)
projects.description: A full-stack recruitment platform designed to streamline interaction between employers and job seekers. Features secure authentication, role-based access, dynamic job posting management, application tracking, and responsive UI architecture for seamless user experience.

projects.title: Allkits App
projects.description: A modern MERN-stack e-commerce application built for product management and scalable online shopping workflows. Includes responsive product browsing, CRUD-based inventory management, and a clean UI optimized for usability across devices.

projects.title: Game Library
projects.description: A dynamic gaming discovery platform powered by API integration and advanced filtering capabilities. Users can browse titles by genre, platform, and popularity while interacting with animated UI transitions powered by GSAP.
